import requests, numpy as np, os, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
W="/tmp/w"; os.makedirs(W,exist_ok=True)
def get(u,p):
    r=S.get(u,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); open(p,"w").write(r.text); return p
def parse_pdb(p):
    A=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and (l[76:78].strip() or "C")!="H":
            try: xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
            except ValueError: continue
            A.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),alt=l[16],resn=l[17:20].strip(),chain=l[21],resi=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array(xyz)))
    return A
def parse_cif(p):
    cols=[];A=[];inl=False
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(l.strip().split(".")[1]); inl=True; continue
        if inl and l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            d=dict(zip(cols,l.split()))
            A.append(dict(name=d["label_atom_id"],resn=d["label_comp_id"],resi=int(d["label_seq_id"]),
                          xyz=np.array([float(d["Cartn_x"]),float(d["Cartn_y"]),float(d["Cartn_z"])]),b=float(d["B_iso_or_equiv"])))
        elif inl and l.startswith("#") and A: break
    return A
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/5I35.pdb",f"{W}/5i35.pdb")
c5=[a for a in parse_pdb(f"{W}/5i35.pdb") if a["chain"]=="A" and a["alt"] in " A"]
def cad(ats,lo,hi):
    d={};rn={}
    for a in ats:
        if a["name"]=="CA" and lo<=a["resi"]<=hi: d.setdefault(a["resi"],a["xyz"]); rn.setdefault(a["resi"],a["resn"])
    r=sorted(d); return np.array(r),np.array([d[i] for i in r]),[rn[i] for i in r]
r1,X1,n1=cad(c5,251,647); L1=len(r1)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def align(X2,L2):
    d0=max(1.24*(min(L1,L2)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5); g=-0.6
    def fit(pairs):
        if len(pairs)<6: return 0.0,None,None
        i=np.array([p[0] for p in pairs]); j=np.array([p[1] for p in pairs]); P,Q=X1[i],X2[j]
        keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
        for cut in [99,8,6,4.5,3.5,3,3]:
            R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); dd=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1); nk=dd<cut
            if nk.sum()<20: break
            keep=nk
        R,t=kabsch(P[keep],Q[keep]); Xt=(R@X1.T).T+t
        dall=np.linalg.norm(Xt[i]-X2[j],axis=1)
        return float(np.sum(1/(1+(dall/d0)**2))/min(L1,L2)),R,t
    def dp(Xt):
        D=np.linalg.norm(Xt[:,None,:]-X2[None,:,:],axis=2); Sm=1/(1+(D/d0)**2)
        F=np.zeros((L1+1,L2+1)); P=np.zeros((L1+1,L2+1),np.int8); ar=np.arange(1,L2+1)
        for i in range(1,L1+1):
            diag=F[i-1,:-1]+Sm[i-1]; up=F[i-1,1:]+g
            best=np.maximum(diag,up); a=best-g*ar
            u=np.maximum.accumulate(a)
            F[i,1:]=u+g*ar
            frm=np.where(diag>=up,0,1)
            P[i,1:]=np.where(a>=u,frm,2)
        cand=max([(F[L1,q],L1,q) for q in range(L2+1)]+[(F[i,L2],i,L2) for i in range(L1+1)])
        _,i,q=cand; pr=[]
        while i>0 and q>0:
            p=P[i,q]
            if p==0: pr.append((i-1,q-1)); i-=1; q-=1
            elif p==1: i-=1
            else: q-=1
        return pr[::-1]
    best=(0,None)
    for off in range(-(L2-40),L1-40,2):
        i=np.arange(max(0,off),min(L1,L2+off)); q=i-off
        if len(i)<40: continue
        tm,R,t=fit(list(zip(i,q)))
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,(R,t))
    R,t=best[1]; pairs=[]
    for it in range(5):
        pairs=dp((R@X1.T).T+t); tm,R2,t2=fit(pairs)
        if R2 is None: break
        R,t=R2,t2
    return tm,pairs
targets={"ADCK5_human":("Q3MIX3",130,470),"ADCK1_human":("Q86TW2",85,430),"ADCK2_human":("Q7Z695",160,520),
         "COQ8B_human":("Q96D53",135,480),"Coq8p_yeast":("P27697",115,460),"Cqd1_yeast":("Q02981",150,560),
         "Cqd2_yeast":("Q06567",120,500),"UbiB_ecoli":("P0A6A0",95,480)}
diag={276:"KxGQ Lys",279:"KxGQ Gln",336:"b1",337:"A-rich 1",338:"A-rich 2",339:"A-rich 3",340:"A-rich Ser",
      344:"b2",356:"b3",358:"b3 Lys",411:"aC Glu",431:"b5",445:"hinge",446:"hinge",447:"hinge",448:"hinge",
      490:"cat loop",492:"cat loop",493:"cat Asn",495:"cat loop",506:"DFG-1",507:"Mg Asp"}
order=sorted(diag)
pos1={int(r):i for i,r in enumerate(r1)}
res={}
for name,(acc,lo,hi) in targets.items():
    f=f"{W}/{acc}.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f): get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.cif",f)
    at=parse_cif(f); r2,X2,n2=cad(at,lo,hi); L2=len(r2)
    tm,pairs=align(X2,L2)
    mp={int(r1[i]):(int(r2[j]),AA3.get(n2[j],"X")) for i,j in pairs}
    res[name]=dict(tm=tm,npairs=len(pairs),map={c:mp.get(c,(None,"-")) for c in order})
    print("%-12s %-7s TM %.3f, %3d aligned CA | %s"%(name,acc,tm,len(pairs),
          " ".join("%s%d%s"%(AA3.get(n1[pos1[c]],"X"),c,mp.get(c,(None,"-"))[1]) for c in order)))
json.dump({k:{"tm":v["tm"],"npairs":v["npairs"],"map":{str(c):[v["map"][c][0],v["map"][c][1]] for c in order}} for k,v in res.items()},
          open(f"{W}/fam_struct.json","w"))
names=list(res)
ref=[AA3.get(n1[pos1[c]],"X") for c in order]
mat=np.array([[1.0 if res[k]["map"][c][1]==ref[j] else 0.0 for j,c in enumerate(order)] for k in names])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(14,4.6))
ax.imshow(mat,cmap="Blues",vmin=0,vmax=1.7,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_xticklabels(["%s%d\n%s"%(ref[j],c,diag[c]) for j,c in enumerate(order)],fontsize=7,rotation=90)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_yticklabels(["%s  (TM %.2f)"%(n.replace("_"," "),res[n]["tm"]) for n in names],fontsize=8)
for i,n in enumerate(names):
    for j,c in enumerate(order): ax.text(j,i,res[n]["map"][c][1],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_title("COQ8A AMP-PNP contact residues mapped across the UbiB family by structural alignment\n(AlphaFold models onto PDB 5I35; blue = identical to COQ8A)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
